rules.reason: The organization profile repository (.github) holds the organization's profile README and default community-health files; it is not a product repository, so its README is not a presentation target.
An archived repository is read-only upstream; a README pull request cannot be opened against it.
A fork carries another project's code and README; presenting it would present that project, not an authorized Aspose product.
Owner ruling R30 (2026-11-13): PDF Go MCP is an MCP server, out of scope at this stage (maybe in future).
